metrics.notes: 57 distinct identifiable employers/companies were surfaced across fresh HH/job-board result pages in Yekaterinburg, Novosibirsk, Samara, Kazan, Nizhny Novgorod and Rostov-on-Don. Recruiters, anonymous employers, public/state/very large unsuitable employers, duplicate employer rows and roles without a sufficiently strong business-change signal were rejected at FAST GATE. Five low-overlap candidates received deeper checks. RODNO was rejected because the matched legal entity ООО СК КОНКОРД / INN 5908075828 has a current liquidation signal; ETK KRONA was rejected because the sales-director vacancy found was archived/stale for this run; Germes-Ural was rejected because the employer-to-legal-entity mapping remained ambiguous; Future Vision was not staged because an exact publication date for the current vacancy could not be independently confirmed from fresh sources. RST Energo passed all required gates. Exact INN repository search immediately before write returned no matches for RST Energo. No canonical files were modified and no outreach was performed.
